observations.footwork: White boxer stationary in orthodox stance, black trainer moving minimally at the left edge of frame.
observations.guard: White boxer has hands held up near the chin.
observations.upper_body: White boxer is in a ready posture, facing forward.
observations.notable: Black trainer is holding a green stick or long pad off to the side.

observations.footwork: Black trainer steps into the center frame, moving towards the white boxer. White boxer begins weight shifts.
observations.guard: White boxer maintains a high guard while moving.
observations.upper_body: White boxer turns slightly to the right, addressing the incoming trainer.
observations.notable: Black trainer enters the center of the frame, bringing the pad into play.

observations.footwork: Boxers are in close proximity, taking small shuffling steps to maintain balance.
observations.guard: Both fighters have hands up in an engaged position.
observations.upper_body: White boxer throws straight punches towards the green pad held by the black trainer.
observations.notable: Padwork exchange occurs at close range.

movement_events.detail: Black trainer steps in from the left, closing the distance toward the white boxer.
White boxer extends arms and throws straight punches at the trainer's pad.
White boxer retracts arms and resets to guard position.
